description: This file defines an interface class IController for IPC communication in the Rialto server manager component. It declares virtual methods for client management, configuration, ping, state setting, and log level control, and includes necessary headers and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface class for controlling IPC client interactions within the Rialto server manager.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client connection with specified server ID and socket.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes the client associated with the specified server ID.

methods.name: performSetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a server, including session state, socket name, display name, resource capabilities, and permissions.

methods.name: performPing
methods.description: Performs a ping operation to check server responsiveness.

methods.name: performSetState
methods.description: Sets the session server state for a given server ID.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for the service.
